 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news The SSA staggers the 71.6 million payments it makes throughout each month depending on the benefit received, birth date and when they began to be claimed.
 Getty Images Social Security Who gets the average Social Security check for $1,943 in October? These are the payment dates this month
 William Allen Greg Heilman Roddy Cons twitter Update: Oct 20th, 2026 05:16 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google The Social Security Administration handles a massive number of payments each month, over 71.6 million as of September 2026. In order to manage the workload efficiently, those disbursements are staggered based on the benefit received, birth date and when a beneficiary began claiming Social Security. 
 According to the agency’s official benefits schedule , SSA payments started for this month on Thursday, October 1, with Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits. 
 Who gets the average $1,943 Social Security benefit? 
 The latest figures from the SSA show that the average monthly Social Security benefit is $1,943.15 . No specific group of beneficiaries receives a $1,943.15 payment, with that figure an average across all Social Security beneficiaries , whose individual payments vary depending on their benefit type and circumstances . On the other hand, the average SSI benefit stands at $735.86 per month. 
 The $1,943.15 figure is based on the SSA’s latest Monthly Statistical Snapshot , which covers September 2026. It includes the different types of beneficiaries who receive Social Security, including people receiving retirement, disability and survivor benefits .
 Social Security retirement: $2,034.54 
 Social Security disability: $1,499.41 
 Social Security survivor: $1,636.31 
 When does October 2026’s three-Wednesdays cycle kick in?
 Of the 71.6 million Americans who receive Social Security benefits, many are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month. These recipients’ designated payment day is determined by their date of birth.
 In October 2026, this three-Wednesdays payment cycle kicked off on October 14 :
 Born on the 1st-10th of any month: Wednesday, October 14 
 Born on the 11th-20th of any month: Wednesday, October 21 
 Born on the 21st-31st of any month: Wednesday, October 28 
 NB: If you get Social Security benefits based on someone else’s work record, the SSA uses the other person’s date of birth .
 October’s other Social Security payment date
 Per the SSA’s official calendar, there is one further Social Security payment run in October , a distribution date that is not birthday-dependent:
 Friday, October 2: Social Security paid to some long-term recipients and people who also claim SSI 
 On October 2, the SSA issued this month’s Social Security to beneficiaries who began receiving their monthly payments before May 1997 . Friday 2 was also this month’s Social Security distribution date for recipients who concurrently claim Supplemental Security Income (SSI) .
 Both groups of recipients above typically get their Social Security on the third of the month , but payment was brought forward as October 3 was a non-business day.
 The SSA sent out SSI payments on Thursday, October 1 . SSI is separate from the Social Security program and provides benefits to low-income, low-resource individuals who are over 65, blind or disabled.
